psychology-ru-superadmin.note: Original concise psychology card text and independent local templates generated for this project; no external quote/photo corpus and no MGS template inheritance is intentionally used.
rules: Do not use MGS packs/templates as a donor or fallback for this super-admin pack.
Avoid medical diagnosis, crisis advice, manipulative promises, or protected-class targeting.
Keep as general self-reflection/behavioral prompts, not therapy replacement.

motivation-en-superadmin.note: English motivation cards use original project-written list text, OpenAI-generated cinematic backgrounds, and local ffmpeg-synth audio beds.

Keep text short and mobile-readable.
